purpose: Two independent corrections to the duplication module (TODO 21). (1) duplication class moved from the v8 membership file to the current v9 table -- v6, the file TODO 21 literally named, is itself superseded by v9 and was not used. (2) a PAV/hemizygosity layer added for the first time; the previous candidate (hemi_pav_crosstab.csv) is the OrthoFinder-based call, which ms1-dup's own CLAUDE.md forbids.

duplication.letter_scheme_unchanged: A/S/T/D/C, concatenated -- identical to v8, so the consuming JS needed no change, only the values did

pav.scope: 6,092 candidate hemizygous genes (from an asymmetric HAP1/HAP2 orthogroup), NOT genome-wide -- a gene outside this candidate set gets no `pav` key at all, same convention as ESMFold's 64% coverage.
pav.fields: rel = which haplotype the candidate orthogroup relationship names as absent; confirmed = the DIAMOND verdict (true PAV vs a real hit the candidate call missed); nhits/target/pident/evalue = the contradicting hit's own evidence when confirmed is false.
